evals.prompt: /eng:conventions-audit. lib/server/data/user.data.ts exports getUser(), which calls fetch(); lib/types/user.type.ts declares type UserType; a component has const data = await fetchEvents().
evals.expected_output: Should report getUser as a network read that must be named fetch, UserType as a Type suffix (and a likely re-declaration if a schema infers User), and the bare data name, each with file:line evidence and a severity. Changes no code.
expectations: Flags getUser for a network read

evals.prompt: Audit conventions. apps/web/src/components/marketing/Header.tsx has "use client" and import { ROUTES } from "@/lib/config".
evals.expected_output: Should report the client import of the server-only config barrel, with the by-path import (@/lib/config/routes) as the fix.
expectations: Flags the barrel import from client code

evals.prompt: Audit the monorepo. packages/date-utils has one consumer, apps/web. AGENTS.md has a Deviations line: 'date-utils is a package from day one because the functions workers will import it next quarter'.
evals.expected_output: Should not report early hoisting here: the project records the deviation with its reason, so the project's version wins. Without that line it would be a finding.
expectations: Notes it would be a finding without the recorded reason

evals.prompt: Audit conventions. components/events/EventCard.tsx links to "/dashboard/events" as a string, while lib/config/routes.ts defines ROUTES.dashboard.events.
evals.expected_output: Should report the hardcoded path with the route constant as the fix, and not flag routes.ts itself for containing the literal.
